facts: Fernwood (fernwood.example) has one active offer, Investor Conversations: relationships with equity investors in Europe. Its audience "European seed and Series A investors" is ready. No campaign exists yet; the prepaid balance is $50 with a card on file.
One sales funnel runs for this offer today: "Cold email to meetings" (Lead Sourcing → Sales Cold Email Outreach → AI Meeting Booking), proactive.

A new campaign is created stopped (POST /v1/sales-funnel-campaigns) with a brief: the one text our judge and every AI writer of the campaign read. It starts only after the client's yes in a later message.
expect: Creates the campaign stopped with a brief it wrote from the client's words: one or two plain sentences saying what it aims at, who and how (e.g. conversations with European equity investors by cold email, no pitch of the round), never a list or labels like "Goal:" or "Use only these channels". Sets the $20 a day cap, shows the client the brief and the cap, and asks their yes to start. Never starts it in this turn.
